_comment: Hand-curated state_name corrections where a plaza's own coordinates, its neighbours and the IHMCL PIU/RO place it in a different state than the upstream label. Applied by merge.js on every run. A correction applies only while the upstream value still equals expected_current_state, so it never overrides an upstream fix. Not yet confirmed against NHAI/official sources: see confirmed_against_official_source. Only state_name may be set here.
